description: Update the category, tags or note of one favorite entry; fields you omit stay unchanged. Requires the favorite record id, obtainable from list_favorites. Note that this overwrites the previous value and keeps no history.

category.description: New category; empty string clears it

note.description: New note; empty string clears it

tags.description: New tag array (wholesale replacement); empty array clears it

name: update_favorite
title: Update a Favorite
